screens.notes: Own top-level custom element (app-academic-year-settings-view), sibling to app-teacher-settings-view, not nested inside it or vice versa. Follows lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md throughout: every table is inline-edit (the one exception, module-edit-confirm-modal, is a save-time confirmation gate, not an edit-interaction modal), dependency-blocked deletion decided server-side, and per-row data-element-id is derived at runtime as `<table-elementId>-row-<id>` rather than being a separate top-level elementId — that's why there's one elementId per table, not one per action button. **Three modes, reopened 2026-07-30** (see description_configuracion.md): (A) normal — an existing año académico is selected, training-cycle-table/module-table are filtered to what that year has selected, module-selection-table/module-selection-add-button/module-selection-save-button/module-selection-save-message are all hidden; (B) adding a new año académico — training-cycle-table shows the complete unfiltered list, module-table is hidden, module-selection-table takes its place scoped to the selected ciclo, module-selection-save-button both creates the año académico and persists the selection; (C) adding a new ciclo while an existing año académico is selected — same module-selection-table takeover, scoped to the new ciclo, module-selection-save-button only persists the selection (the año académico already exists). `module-cycle-select` (a `<select>`) from the first pass is removed — redundant now that clicking a training-cycle-table row already selects the ciclo.

components.note: This is the one exception to lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md's 'never a modal' rule — that rule is about the EDIT interaction itself (still inline, in-row, here), not about a save-time confirmation gate. This modal renders inside app-academic-year-settings-view's own Shadow DOM (a conditionally-rendered lit-html block, like login-error-message), never a separate nested custom element.
